notes: Sepolia (11155111) application deployment. The four named artifacts are PriceFeed, NhiFeed, SpotFeed and ParameterizedVault, in constructor dependency order. Each feed takes (maxAge_ in seconds, maxDeviationBps_); the existing settings remain 86400/2000, 86400/2000 and 3600/2000 respectively. ParameterizedVault takes (imdToken_, stablecoin_, oracle_, priceFeed_, nhiFeed_, spotFeed_). The all-ones collateral address is the explicit COLLATERAL_FAUCET sentinel: the constructor replaces it with a fresh MockIMD, rather than depending on an existing collateral deployment. Zero stablecoin_ creates ImdUSD bound to the vault. Zero oracle_ preserves the approved MockWorkOracle grantRights faucet, also bound during construction; it does not select the attested oracle or require WorkOracleFactory. The vault also creates and links Parameters, Treasury and UsdPriceFeed internally. These dependencies are not additional manifest entries. Redemption is implemented by the vault: redeem(amount, minImdOut, candidate) burns COMP for IMD only, spends Treasury IMD first, and covers any shortfall by cancelling debt of an eligible caller-named position. The eligibility ceiling is mat() plus gap, initially 50 ratio points and governed within 25-100 under the existing 48-hour delay. The fee has a source-constant 50 bps floor and 500 bps cap; its base decays with an approximately 12-hour half-life and increases by one quarter of the redeemed fraction of pre-burn supply, subject to the cap. The fee remains as backing with no recipient. This manifest describes the vault as revised for review findings 7cd5035c and 5ee3f2bc, neither of which changed a constructor signature or a manifest argument: the redemption backing guard now reads the public securedCollateral sum, which counts each position's collateral only up to twice the IMD value of its own principal and excludes increases made in the same transaction, so a debt-free deposit adds no backing; and a repayment retires the youngest debt in a position's twelve-hour fresh-debt record first, so a mint-and-repay pair cannot keep older principal fresh. Feeds start unseeded and the Treasury reserve register starts empty. Feed authorities, attestation policy, Chainlink ETH/USD source and governor remain defined in DeploymentConfig.sol; none of the named constructors accepts an owner argument, and no $owner or literal authority address is supplied by this manifest. The manifest includes no ETH funding or initialization calls. Deployment-order dependency recorded from review finding d7f72926: each feed compiles ATTESTATION_RELAYER as its sole submitter, a SwarmRelay already deployed on Sepolia that predates the keeper-bundling functions in the current src/SwarmRelay.sol. Feeds deployed from this manifest accept attestations only through that pinned address; bundled relay-and-mark or relay-and-bite calls require a redeployed relay and a source constant change, neither of which a manifest can perform. This is for the services and independent review to account for, not a constructor input. Policy, authorization, source publication and signed artifact linkage belong to the responsible services and independent review; these notes do not attest that admission or deployment has occurred.
